Container.Name: Hive-Tech-Forum
Container.Overview:
Hive Tech Forum — Next.js forum for tech, servers, and IPTV; free tier and Pro (Stripe).
Image: ghcr.io/killamfkr/hive:latest. Migrations run on container start.
REQUIRED: set AUTH_SECRET (openssl rand -base64 32) and NEXTAUTH_URL to your real URL (https behind a reverse proxy).
REQUIRED: map Host Path to Container Path /data (appdata). Example: /mnt/user/appdata/hive-tech-forum -> /data If the container restarts in a loop, view logs: Unraid Docker tab → find Hive-Tech-Forum in the list → click the container name (or the log icon if shown) → Logs. Or SSH: docker logs Hive-Tech-Forum (or docker logs --tail 200 -f Hive-Tech-Forum). If you see no container row, creation failed — read the red error on Apply or run docker ps -a. Common fixes: chown 1001:1001 on appdata, fix NEXTAUTH_URL, leave optional Stripe/XUI fields blank (not a single space).
If Apply shows Execution error and the container never starts: remove any custom Registry in Advanced (template uses full image path only). On SSH run: docker pull ghcr.io/killamfkr/hive:latest then see unraid/README.md debug section. If docker pull fails with unauthorized, set the GHCR package to public or docker login ghcr.io on Unraid.
Seed categories once: docker exec -it Hive-Tech-Forum sh -c 'cd /app/prisma-migrate && node node_modules/prisma/build/index.js db seed' Stripe webhook: https://your-domain/api/webhooks/stripe
Note: This template intentionally has NO TemplateURL so Unraid does not overwrite your settings when you click Apply. Update the image with Docker pull or recreate the container when the image is updated.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: REQUIRED. SQLite database lives here (forum.db). chown -R 1001:1001 this folder if migrations fail.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: Leave default when using the Appdata mapping above.

Config.Name: SKIP_DB_MIGRATE
Config.Description: Set to 1 only to debug start failures (skips migrations — not for production).

Config.Name: NEXTAUTH_URL
Config.Description: Must match the URL users use in the browser (use https://your.domain if behind Swag/NPM).

Config.Name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Leave completely empty if not using Stripe.

Config.Name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty if not using Stripe.

Config.Name: STRIPE_PRICE_ID_PAID
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty if not using Stripe.

Config.Name: XUI_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Optional. Full URL ending in /accesscode, or leave empty.

Config.Name: XUI_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty if not using XUI.

Config.Name: XUI_BOUQUET_IDS
Config.Description: Comma-separated bouquet IDs for new XUI lines

Config.Name: XUI_MAX_CONNECTIONS
Config.Description: Max concurrent connections per XUI line
